articles.title: Kérastase India Brings Over 100 Women Together for Padel in Gloss, India's First Women ...
articles.content: Industry Watch Articles News Events Sports Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp Kérastase India brought together over 100 women creators, influencers, padel enthusiasts and athletes for Padel in Gloss, a women-only padel platform that brought sport, beauty and lifestyle together. Built around the thought “Gloss On, Game On,” the experience celebrated women embracing movement, self-expression and new challenges. Participants included first-time players, experienced padel enthusiasts and professional athletes. The event featured personalities from entertainment, beauty, fashion and lifestyle, including singer-songwriter Lisa Mishra, actor-creator Sara Sarosh and actor Aditi Bhatia. Professional padel players, including Sakshi Malik, also joined the event, adding a competitive element to the experience. Across the day, participants took to the court while friends and fellow guests cheered from the sidelines. The experience aimed to showcase padel as both an active sport and a social lifestyle activity. Kérastase Gloss Absolu was also an integral part of the experience. The Kérastase hair station allowed guests to explore the range, experience the products first-hand and discover match-day hairstyles. Personalised Gloss Absolu bottles added a bespoke touch, while a café cart gave guests a space to connect and unwind between matches. Anjali Pai, General Manager, Kérastase India said, “Padel in Gloss celebrated the confidence great hair can unlock, giving women the freedom to express themselves and take on new challenges. It was wonderful to see the women give the game their all, feel great in their hair and make the platform their own.” With Padel in Gloss, Kérastase India brought its Gloss On, Game On vision to life, creating a space where women could play, compete, connect and express themselves while bringing beauty and an active lifestyle together.
